2.w: “Is it to God that a strong man is of benefit? Is it to him that even a wise man is profitable?

3.w: Is it of any special benefit to the Almighty that you should be righteous, or is it any gain to him that you make your ways blameless?

4.w: Is it because of your piety that he rebukes you and goes to judgment with you?

5.w: Is not your wickedness great and is there no end to your iniquity?

6.w: “For you took pledges from your brothers for no reason, and you stripped the clothing from the naked.

7.w: You gave the weary no water to drink and from the hungry you withheld food.

8.w: Although you were a powerful man, owning land, an honored man living on it,

9.w: you sent widows away empty-handed, and the arms of the orphans you crushed.

10.w: That is why snares surround you, and why sudden fear terrifies you,

11.w: why it is so dark you cannot see, and why a flood of water covers you.

12.w: “Is not God on high in heaven? And see the lofty stars, how high they are!

13.w: But you have said, ‘What does God know? Does he judge through such deep darkness?

14.w: Thick clouds are a veil for him, so he does not see us, as he goes back and forth in the vault of heaven.’

15.w: Will you keep to the old path that evil men have walked—

16.w: men who were carried off before their time, when the flood was poured out on their foundations?

17.w: They were saying to God, ‘Turn away from us,’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do to us?’

18.w: But it was he who filled their houses with good things— yet the counsel of the wicked was far from me.

19.w: The righteous see their destruction and rejoice; the innocent mock them scornfully, saying,

20.w: ‘Surely our enemies are destroyed, and fire consumes their wealth.’

21.w: “Reconcile yourself with God, and be at peace with him; in this way your prosperity will be good.

22.w: Accept instruction from his mouth and store up his words in your heart.

23.w: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up; if you remove wicked behavior far from your tent,

24.w: and throw your gold in the dust— your gold of Ophir among the rocks in the ravines—

25.w: then the Almighty himself will be your gold, and the choicest silver for you.

26.w: Surely then you will delight yourself in the Almighty and will lift up your face toward God.

27.w: You will pray to him, and he will hear you, and you will fulfill your vows to him.

28.w: Whatever you decide on a matter, it will be established for you, and light will shine on your ways.

29.w: When people are brought low and you say, ‘Lift them up!’ then he will save the downcast;

30.w: he will deliver even someone who is not innocent, who will escape through the cleanness of your hands.”
